source_text: Completa est descriptio hereditatum. Qui accepit sortem custodiat. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Completed is description of-inheritances. Who received lot let-him-guard. Amen.
pass_b_english: The description of inheritances is complete. Whoever received a lot, guard it. Amen.
